0.2.0.notes:
Experimental prototype release for macOS and Linux, version 0.2.0.

These early builds are not a stable release. Native installation testing is incomplete. Builds may crash, lose data, or change without notice. Use only copies of your data and projects; do not rely on these builds for production work.

Choose the DMG for your Mac:
- Apple Silicon: EIDORA-0.2.0-macos-arm64.dmg
- Intel: EIDORA-0.2.0-macos-x86_64.dmg

Both Mac applications are Developer ID signed and notarized. Packaged self-tests passed. The Intel build was tested under Rosetta on Apple Silicon; testing on Intel hardware remains pending.

Quit EIDORA, open the DMG, and drag EIDORA into Applications. Keep a backup of existing projects before opening them with this version.

Mac application source commit: 940b5b38aec5b898c04945aaf08f047a1e24bf73.

Linux x64 downloads:
- AppImage: EIDORA-0.2.0-linux-x86_64.AppImage
- DEB: EIDORA-0.2.0-linux-x86_64.deb

The Linux builds were built and self-tested on Ubuntu 24.04. Other distributions and native installation have not been verified. For AppImage, make the downloaded file executable and run it. For DEB, use your Debian-based distribution's package installer. The DEB installs approximately 1.25 GB of files.

Linux application source commit: f925e94cb77cfba1dc838c8c43e44754a5b927b0.

Prototype software. Use at your own risk. Stability and backward compatibility are not guaranteed.

0.2.1.notes:
Experimental Linux x64 prototype release, version 0.2.1.

Prototype software. Use at your own risk. Stability and backward compatibility are not guaranteed. Use copies of your data and projects.

This Linux-only patch adds developer attribution, the EIDORA homepage, and AppStream metadata. It does not provide a verified publisher badge or a signed APT repository.

Downloads:
- EIDORA-0.2.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage — standalone application; make the file executable before running it.
- EIDORA-0.2.1-linux-x86_64.deb — package for Debian-based distributions; install with your package manager. Installed files occupy approximately 1.25 GB.

The builds were built and self-tested on Ubuntu 24.04. Packaged X11 self-tests, project creation, and the welcome tour passed. Other distributions and native installation/upgrade have not been verified.

Mac downloads remain at version 0.2.0. There is no Windows build in this release.

Application source commit: 443fde7bdc009e507f0e738565103c96d6f34726.
